NAS 4-Bay (zonder HDD maar met stroom kabel) 4-Bay

ideaal voor video editing

Looking for an affordable desktop multi-drive storage system? Sonnet’s Fusion QR should be on your short list.
This versatile 4-drive RAID 5 SATA storage system delivers reliable operation, simple configuration, and flexible connection options in a small, budget-friendly package. Available without drives, and in 8TB, 12TB, and 16TB configurations(1), this Sonnet storage system is equipped with a high-performance internal storage controller that manages the enclosed 3.5″ hard drives and offers five drive configuration options (including RAID 5). Its USB 3.0, eSATA, and dual FireWire® 800 ports provide you flexibility in connecting the system to just about any computer. The QR even includes a built-in carrying handle to make this rugged and lightweight system highly portable.

What are the Key Features of this HDD Enclosure
Protected Data—RAID 5 support offers enhanced security for your critical files, providing data protection in case one of the drives fails
RAID Controller Onboard—Integrated hardware RAID controller supports RAID 5, RAID 0, RAID 10, JBOD, and span drive configurations with no specialized controller card needed
Quad Interface—Choice of USB 3.0, dual Fire Wire 800, and locking eSATA interfaces; three cables included
Simple Configuration—A simple switch enables you to select RAID modes and configure the drives to meet your performance and data security needs
Simple Status Display—Determine operating status at a glance
Highly Portable—Rugged and lightweight enclosure with built-in handle allows the QR to be picked up and moved easily and securely
Quiet Fan—Low fan noise level makes this Fusion storage system suitable for use in noise-sensitive environments
Four 3.5” Swappable Drive Modules

Unmatched 4‑Bay NAS Performance: The F4‑424 Max is driven by an Intel® Core™ i5‑1235U 10‑core processor, equipped with 8GB of DDR5 memory, dual 10GbE ports, and dual M.2 NVMe SSD cache slots. The TOS 7 operating system provides multi‑layered protection: TFSS snapshots for instant recovery, Duple Backup for a 3‑2‑1 strategy, and Centralized Backup for business environments.
Professional OS with Effortless Expansion: The system comes pre‑installed with TOS 7, supporting Docker, virtual machines, and various business applications. It features tool‑free drive trays and a slide‑open M.2 SSD cover for quick setup, and storage can be easily expanded by connecting TerraMaster DAS devices.
